integrity: Proof based on CRT valuation strata and rational sums, with independent direct big-integer and finite-prefix tests; no external independent validation asserted.
scientific_limitations: The exact one-site digit evaluation and strict 75-automaticity are prior literature; the new claim is the complete ordered adjacent-pair frequency law, its sharp 20-edge support and an O(log-squared N) count error. No law for longer words or mixing is claimed. Literature priority remains subject to unindexed equivalents.
title: Exact adjacent-digit law for a composite-base automatic number-theory sequence
